|title=Those Who Fight

== Summary ==
:{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}
Rand tells the Dark One that it is not about him and it never was. Rather, it was about:

* A woman that was cast down from her throne and made a puppet ([[Morgase]])
* A man that remembered stories ([[Thom]])
* A woman who had given her life and had it returned ([[Moiraine]])
* A man whose family had been taken from him ([[Perrin]])
* A woman who refused to believe she could not Heal those harmed ([[Nynaeve]])
* A hero who insisted with every breath that he wasn't a hero ([[Mat]]/[[Lan]])
* A woman who shone with the Light for all to see ([[Egwene]])

He tells the Dark One that he can only win if he breaks the will of the people and that won't happen. As long as there are people in the world there is humanity.

The Dark One replies he can still kill and that all are his eventually; he is the Lord of the Grave. All are his, including the [[Matrim Cauthon|battle lord]]. 

Rand stretches out his palm, containing the world, and on the battlefield, two bodies on the ground.

:{{pov|[[Matrim Cauthon]]}}
Mat fights, killing Trollocs, thinking that this is their chance to break them while the Sharans are in disarray.

:{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}
Rand hears the Dark One say he will take the Son of Battles as he took the [[Al'Lan Mandragoran|King of Nothing]]'s kingdom.

:{{pov|[[Matrim Cauthon]]}}
[[Gerard Arganda|Arganda]] says they are being overwhelmed, that they need to step back, but Mat thinks he can do it. He just needs a favorable toss of the dice, something to give momentum.

:{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}
Rand tells the Dark One that he was not watching closely enough and he was very wrong about one thing.

:{{pov|[[Olver]]}}
Olver - in his terrified desperation - blows the [[Horn of Valere]].

:{{pov|[[Matrim Cauthon]]}}
Mat hears Rand in his head, telling Shai'tan he is wrong; that the one whom he has tried to kill, from whom he took everything, still fights. 

Point of view: ''[[Lan Mandragoran]]'' 

Lan stands up holding Demandred's head. 

The battlefield goes still and over the silence, the Horn of Valere is heard.

:{{pov|[[Elayne Trakand]]}}
[[Daved Hanlon|Hanlon]] tells Elayne she should have been more accommodating. She feels foolish for not listening to [[Birgitte Silverbow|Birgitte]] that just because her babies will be fine, does not mean she will. 

White mist rises from the ground and Hanlon stiffens, a silvery arrow through his chest. A second shot takes him on the head and a third takes out the Dreadlord. She sees Birgitte standing over her corpse. She smiles and tells Elayne that the Heroes of the Horn have returned. 

:{{pov|[[Matrim Cauthon]]}}
Mat fights through the Shadow's forces to Lan, grabbing him as he falls over. [[Jahar Narishma|Narishma]] joins him and briefly Heals him, bringing him back to consciousness. Mat hears the horn and wonders who blew it; he reckons that his death at [[Rhuidean]] severed his connection to it. He then sees the Heroes galloping in. [[Artur Paendrag Tanreall|Artur Hawkwing]] steps to the front as Mat sees one of them ride off. 

Hawkwing tells Mat that they need the banner, but that they would never fight for the Shadow. The heroes chastise Mat for not showing proper respect and gratitude to the Dragon Reborn as he saved him twice and his life is owed to him. Mat suggests that he can pull his men back and allow the heroes to fight, which amuses Hawkwing, as there are far too many, even for the Heroes of the Horn.

:{{pov|[[Olver]]}}
As Olver continues to blow the Horn, it is ripped from his hands, then he is pulled from his hiding place. He is dropped and looks up to see a figure fighting off a dozen Trollocs. He recognizes him as [[Jain Charin|Noal]], though with the weariness gone. 

Noal tells him that he did indeed die, but that the Pattern was not finished with him and tells Olver to sound the horn. Olver feels a great warmth, for one of the people he lost has come back to him.
